family_selection.verifier_required: reference solution passes and an empty solution fails; inspect validation assertions for prompt consistency
family_selection.headroom_required: reference intervention improves validation success, or preserves success and reduces online tokens by at least 10 percent
family_selection.failed_or_inconclusive_families: retain all validation results and exclusion reasons; never select families by test outcomes

test_policy.content_access: after final implementation and interventions are frozen
test_policy.learning: offline only; no test feedback enters subsequent tasks
test_policy.retry: infrastructure failures are reported separately; retain every attempt and its cost
